QuestInfo.name: Hoblin Weapon
QuestInfo.0: #bCategory: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Optional Quest\r\n Content: #bTylus#k says that he has something to ask of you before you leave to prevent the resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain #b1 #t4032648:##k, used by the Ferocious Hoblins, and bring it to #bTylus#k.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained #b1 #t4032648:##k and brought it to #bTylus#k.

0.0: Let me give you some advice before you head over to the Ice Ravine. Watch out for Hoblins! Especially those #bFerocious Hoblins#k! Back in my day, I fought some difficult battles against them. Hey, since you're going there anyway, can I ask for a favor?

yes.0: I, like any other strong warrior, love strong weapons. Can you bring me one #b#t4032648:##k? It's a weapons used by the Ferocious Hoblins.

no.0: I guess it was too much for me to ask. Please come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Oh, did you bring the weapon I asked you for?

yes.0: Yes, this is it! Thank you. Why did I ask you to bring back something I'm not even going to use? Haha, it's just a hobby of mine. Anyway, I'm glad to see you safe and sound.\r\n

item.0: Please bring be #b1 #t4032648:##k used by the Ferocious Hoblins.
